doc.title: Don Alias interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 6, 2002

chapter: Jaco, Weather Report and pop work
title: Favorite pop artists: Joni Mitchell, Fogelberg, Ian Hunter
summary: Asked about pop work, he names Joni Mitchell, Dan Fogelberg's platinum record, and a record with Jaco and Ian Hunter.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Session players on the hits: "I played on that record"

blocks.x: Right. Of the Pop people, sometimes it’s hard to make a distinction but of the Pop artists you’ve worked with, who have you enjoyed the most?

Joni Mitchell, great band. Dan Fogelberg. That’s my only — oh no that’s not the only one — I think “Bitches Brew” is but a platinum record, I got a platinum record for that one called “Innocent Age.” And Ian Hunter — me and Jaco did him. English.
Yeah, English guy, yeah, he made a record with me and Jaco. I think it’s Ian Hunter.
Was he in one of the Rock ‘n Roll bands?
